SET timestamp=1747802400;
# 与 test.products 表一致：列 id, created_at, updated_at, code, price
# 已有索引 idx_code_price_time(code, price, created_at)
# 本 SQL 仅按 price 过滤且未带 code，复合索引左侧前缀用不上，易全表扫描
SELECT *
FROM products
WHERE price >= 100
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
